card.name: Condition words that lead into a complication
card.fires_on: The last word of a disease name, often 'diabetic' or 'diabetes', right before a complication or related condition (neuropathy, ketoacidosis, foot ulcers). Also 'with' after a condition and endings of names like hypoglycemic or herpes zoster.

modes.label: Diabetic before complication
modes.description: 'diabetic' or 'diabetes' placed before a complication term such as neuropathy, ketoacidosis, nerve disease or foot ulcers.

modes.label: End of a disease name
modes.description: The last piece of a condition name that is followed by another condition or event word.
modes.example: Severe hypoglycemia leading to hypoglyc<<emic>> seizures has been observed with INCRELEX

modes.label: Linking 'with' after a condition
modes.description: The word 'with' joining a condition to an accompanying problem.
modes.example: Nephritis<< with>> Renal Dysfunction JEMPERLI can

card.plain: It fires on a disease word when the next words will likely name a complication or accompanying condition.
